packMeta.name: Finance OS (US) (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey US RIA & wealth compliance workbench: client onboarding, SEC Form CRS & W-9 tracking, Reg BI risk tolerance scorer, tiered AUM fee agreement calculator, ACAT/Rollover/1035 transfers hub, 100%-validated beneficiary designations, POA, annual reviews and document vault. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 10 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
